newsitem.title: UK: PERKINS BUYS DUTCH DISSELKOEN GROUP.
newsitem.headline: PERKINS BUYS DUTCH DISSELKOEN GROUP.

text.p: Perkins Foods Plc said on Wednesday it is to buy Disselkoen Group (Netherlands), a leading exporter of Dutch grown fresh produce for 15.6 million stg.
Perkins will pay for the deal via a one for six rights issue at 74 pence a share, raising 15.5 million stg net of expenses.
Perkins will pay 8.7 million stg in cash and 6.9 million in shares for Disselkoen, which will expand Perkins' fresh produce division.
Disselkoen made pretax profits of 2.6 million stg in 1995, on turnover of 184.2 million.

Perkins chief executive Howard Phillips said, "The combination of the Disselkoen Group with Perkins Foods' fresh produce division will create one of the largest full service distributors of fresh produce to European supermarkets."
